            bestDen = y;

        long long diff1 = abs(a * y - b * x);
        long long diff2 = abs(a * bestDen - b * bestNum);

            bestDen = y;

        if (diff1 * bestDen < diff2 * y) {
            bestNum = x;
            bestDen = y;
        }
    }
    
    cout << bestNum << "/" << bestDen << endl;
    return 0;
